title: HDL Dev schematic spec
description: Validates schematic specs under docs/schematics/specs. The name controls SCHEMATIC=<name> and the generated SVG filename.

name.description: Spec identifier. This should match the filename stem and the Make SCHEMATIC value.

extends.description: Base schematic spec name to inherit. This is a spec name, not a file path.

title.description: Human-readable title for generated schematic documentation.

top.description: Top VHDL entity for base schematic specs. Inherited specs may omit top.

include_cell_types.description: Regex filters for cell types to keep.

exclude_cell_types.description: Regex filters for cell types to remove.

include_cell_names.description: Regex filters for cell names to keep.

exclude_cell_names.description: Regex filters for cell names to remove.

include_ports.description: Regex filters for top-level ports to keep.

exclude_ports.description: Regex filters for top-level ports to remove.

include_cell_ports.description: Regex filters for nested cell ports to keep.

exclude_cell_ports.description: Regex filters for nested cell ports to remove.

include_glue_cell_types.description: Regex filters for glue cells included around focused paths.

include.description: HDL Dev fixture alias for a small include list. Prefer GEnCor-compatible include/exclude fields in project specs.
